content: Sync-state UX pattern: show per-item status near object (Local saved/Queued/Syncing/Synced/Partially synced/Failed/Conflict needs review) plus queue-level counts; separate device-local persistence from remote acceptance - green Synced only after server/target accepts. Last-successful-sync timestamp is more concrete than spinner. Keep network/online badge separate from record status; never show old server value over pending local edit; persistent problems need visible action (retry/edit/discard), not toasts. Firestore hasPendingWrites/fromCache flags illustrate but fromCache misleading if no cache allowed.
